cards.question: Please give both venue names from my venue records: the exact name of the current booked venue, and the exact name of the former venue it replaced. Clearly say which is current and which is former.
cards.response: Okay, I'll try to get this right based on what you've said. According to your records, the current booked venue is Plover Annex. The former venue that it replaced was Larch Reading Room. I remember you mentioning both of those names, and how you corrected the record from the first one to the second one.

requested_fields.current_venue: exact name of the current booked venue
requested_fields.former_venue: exact name of the former venue

sources.text: I have booked the practice exercise in Larch Reading Room. That is the venue on my booking record. What surroundings help you concentrate on a conversation?

There is also a correction to my venue record: the practice has moved from Larch Reading Room to Plover Annex. Plover Annex is now the booked venue; Larch Reading Room is the former venue. How would you let a partner know about a venue change?
